content.title: Use the catalog CTA on the home page to reach the published books catalog
content.intent: Prove that the home-page CTA for browsing all published books takes the visitor to `/books`.
content.technique_notes: Applied source-grounded happy-path coverage to the explicit catalog outbound route. Kept separate from the recently published title route because the outcomes differ: this path must land on `/books`, while a recent-book title must land on a specific book detail page. Budget rank 3/4 because it covers one of the use-case's named public branch choices.
